Arthur folded the paper, set it beside the logbook, and took up his cleaning rag.", "w02": "凌晨四点，街灯投下橘黄的光晕，柏油路面泛着微冷的水汽。环卫工人的扫帚划过落叶，发出干脆的沙沙声。高架桥上唯有冷链货车疾驰而过，远处的货运站隐现微红的尾灯。便利店的白炽光在浓重墨色里撑开一角，整座城池仍在深沉的呼吸中等待破晓。", "w03": "* Recursion is when a rule solves a big task by repeating itself on a smaller piece of that task.\n* Think of opening a Russian nesting doll: each doll contains a smaller twin until you reach the solid baby doll at the centre.\n* That tiny doll is the stop sign, which tells the pattern to finish without running forever."}
